thread:
maya: Heads-up — after the prefetch/cache flush last night a subset of orgs are showing $0 or NaN on the token-cost dashboard. Sample org: org_8245, org_9982. Screenshot attached: https://redwood.internal/snap/ajk23.png :eyes:

luis: Can you paste repro steps and a query/trace? Is this only the cost tiles or also the ledger CSVs?

maya: Repro steps I used: 1) Hit dashboard for org_8245 -> token-cost tile shows $0. 2) Pulled ledger rows via API /v1/ledgers?org=org_8245 -> entries present. 3) Ran the dashboard aggregation query locally and saw NaN in join result.

maya: Minimal repro SQL I ran:
```
SELECT o.org_id, SUM(t.tokens * p.price) as cost
FROM token_usage t
JOIN price_lookup p ON t.model = p.model
LEFT JOIN org_overrides o ON t.org_id = o.org_id
WHERE t.org_id = 'org_8245'
GROUP BY o.org_id;
```
Result: cost = NULL / NaN for some rows.

sophie: Opening an official ticket for affected customers and CCing account teams. Affected orgs list I have so far: org_8245, org_9982, org_4410, org_7701. Sending email updates.

oncall-ml: Saw something in the prefetch job logs around 02:14 UTC where the KV cache flush returned partial keys. Looks like the prefetch job switched to the new streaming reader and we started getting empty price_lookup payloads for certain shards. Excerpt from job logs:
```
2026-03-16T02:14:12Z prefetcher INFO shard=12 fetch_price_lookup -> payload_size=0
2026-03-16T02:14:12Z prefetcher WARN shard=12 fallback_to_db=true
```
That would explain why the join returns NULL since price_lookup rows missing -> price=NULL -> cost NULL.

maya: Good catch. The dashboard code treats NULL price as 0 in some paths but multiplies by tokens in others, leading to NaNs after the aggregation step.

ashley: I'm on it — I'll validate whether the streaming reader change was deployed yesterday (it was) and run a targeted re-run of prefetch for affected shards. ETA 30m. If we can repopulate KV, front-end should show correct numbers after cache warm.

luis: For immediate mitigation can we change the dashboard query to coalesce price to 0 for display only so customers don't see NaN? Quick patch on the UI would help while we fix the prefetch job.

ashley: Agreed. I'll open a quick PR to coalesce(price,0) in the reporting layer and cut a hotfix.

devops-bot: deploy-logs: hotfix-ui-coalesce deployed to staging at 2026-03-16T03:12Z, queued for production 2026-03-16T03:18Z.

sophie: Notifying affected customers that we have a rollback/hotfix plan and will follow up when numbers are stable.

oncall-ml: Postmortem notes for eng: streaming reader introduced a short window where price_lookup payloads can be empty during shard rotation. Need to add validation in prefetch pipeline to never write empty payloads and to emit metrics when fallback_to_db=true.

maya: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for status. Will update when backfilled and tiles verify.

luis: Once KV backfill completes can someone paste the dashboard tile query results (org, cost) so I can confirm for the 4 affected orgs?

ashley: Backfill started 2026-03-16T03:45Z, completed 2026-03-16T04:08Z for shards 10-14. Verified dashboard for org_8245 now shows $12,345.67.

maya: Confirmed for org_8245 and org_9982. Marking as resolved for now, will leave in monitoring for 24h. :white_check_mark:
